_readme: Checkout links from Lemon Squeezy (product > Share), store ID and customer billing page. Set "live" to true only once the links are LIVE-mode links (store activated, products copied to live mode); until then everyone stays in launch mode and nothing is locked. Add ?paywall=1 to the site address to test the paywall with test-mode links. ownerHash is the fingerprint of the creator's lifetime key (the key itself is never stored here).
